test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian state has the largest mica reserves?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• India has the** largest reserve of mica** in the world. 
 
• The state of **Andhra Pradesh** is the largest producer of mica.
 
• Mica (crude) production is well-known in **Andhra Pradesh's Nellore district.**
 
• Other notable mica-producing **districts **include **Vishakhapatnam, West Godavari, and Krishna.**
 
• The states of **Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan, Bihar, and Jharkhand** produce the **majority of mica (waste and scrap).**
 
• Andhra Pradesh ranks first among mica-producing states, generating** 1,660 tonnes of crude mica **and** 7,626 tonnes of waste and scrap mica** in the **2013-14 fiscal year.**
 
• **State-wise total resource distribution of Mica** is as follows:-
 
 
• Andhra Pradesh leads with a 41% share of the country’s total resources followed by
 
• Rajasthan (21%)
 
• Odisha (20%)
 
• Maharashtra (15%)
 
• Bihar (2%) and
 
• The remaining 1% is in Jharkhand and Telangana together.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mica is** India's most important export.**
 
• Certain types of Indian mica are and will continue to be important to the **global electrical industry.**
 
• The ports of** Kolkata and Vishakhapatnam **handle the majority of exports.
 
• **Japan (19%), the United States (17%), the United Kingdom**, and other countries are** major importers **of Indian mica.
